title: Sign correlation and relative Hamming distance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\{−1,1\}$. The uniform mean of the pointwise product $f(x)g(x)$ is $1-2d_H(f,g)/|\Omega|$, where $d_H(f,g)$ is the number of points of $\Omega$ on which $f$ and $g$ differ.
